data.name: Recoil Trainer
data.detailed_description:
Abstract

Recoil Trainer is a training and visualization tool designed to help FPS players understand, practice, and improve recoil control and mid-range aiming skills.

Instead of only showing a static recoil pattern, Recoil Trainer focuses on how the recoil should actually be controlled over time. It can turn weapon patterns into clear visual guides, controller-friendly movement curves, and audio timing cues, helping you practice recoil control in a more structured way.

Key Features

Recoil Pattern Reconstruction

Rebuild recoil patterns from images or videos, then analyze the movement of the pattern frame by frame.

Mouse and Controller Guidance

Generate visual training guides for both mouse and controller users. Mouse guidance focuses on position-space movement, while controller guidance focuses on velocity-space stick control.

Recoil Strength Visualization

See how recoil intensity changes over time, making it easier to understand when to pull harder, softer, left, or right.

Audio Guidance

Use timing-based audio cues to help train recoil rhythm and directional changes without constantly looking at the guide.

Floating Overlay Mode

Display recoil guidance in a floating window while practicing, so you can follow the pattern more directly.

Mid-Range Training

Practice additional aiming concepts such as target leading, movement compensation, bullet drop awareness, and target direction changes.

Steam Workshop Support

Import and share compatible training profiles through Steam Workshop.

Important Notes

Recoil Trainer is an independent training tool. It does not modify any game files, read game memory, inject code, provide macros, automate input, or bypass anti-cheat systems.

This software is designed for practice, visualization, and learning only. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by any game developer, publisher, platform, or tournament organizer.
